title: General Hecke Generator Witness
objective: Emit and validate Hecke v2 compact witnesses for literal exported class-generator coordinate products without reinterpreting retained v1 evidence

oracles: Pinned Hecke 0.40.0 class-map source and exact small-field principal-ideal equality; distinguish local 0.39.22 smoke

runs.command: env JULIA_PKG_PRECOMPILE_AUTO=0 JULIA_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 /home/user/.julia/juliaup/julia-1.12.7+0.x64.linux.gnu/bin/julia --startup-file=no --compiled-modules=existing --pkgimages=existing --project=/tmp/hecke-generator-witness-env-EvWEZU -e using Hecke; @assert Base.pkgversion(Hecke) == v"0.40.0"; include("bench/class-unit-groups/general-frontier/reference/hecke/generator-witness-smoke.jl")

handoff.summary: Hecke v2 emits a compact witness for the literal exported class-generator product using one factored principality call, preserves the reduced map image as diagnostic data, and keeps retained v1 representative-witness semantics separate through validation and normalization. Exact regressions pass 44 assertions on both local 0.39.22 and retained pinned 0.40.0 source. Fresh post-commit receipts pass 34 runner tests, 19 persistent tests, strict Python (389 modules), the pinned 0.40.0 exact regression, and local 0.39.22 transport smoke at 100/200 bits. No resource, sampling, regulator or PARI changes.
risks: This is structural screening, conditional on GRH, not independent replay or qualified benchmark evidence; historical v1 timings do not measure the strengthened v2 work.

Local validation uses Julia 1.12.7, Hecke 0.39.22/Nemo 0.56.1 and retained Hecke 0.40.0 source revision 66af28e52682620edb302931fce3f9ac87fc4eb7 with the deployed dependency versions; it does not attest deployed-host caches or non-Linux platforms.
One existing persistent duplicate-response test failed intermittently before passing unchanged on rerun; the failed receipt is retained and no transport race fix is included.

Required native and broader build-dependent gates remain unmet in this unbuilt narrow worktree. Fresh exact-base test:changed passed merge checks then failed on missing dist/vendor/tree-sitter-sage.wasm; fresh architecture:check failed on the same missing asset. Architecture:check initially lacked dist/tools/cli. The accidental origin/main changed-check build was stopped after TypeScript compilation. Failed receipts are retained and the contract remains active, not review.
next_steps: Integration should rerun the build-dependent unit/native/architecture gates and investigate the existing duplicate-response race separately.
Repin deployed worker source before any authorized controlled sampling; disclose v2's strengthened witness boundary and unchanged asymmetric regulator guarantees.
Broader matched class/unit-map probe coverage, 100/200-bit regulator qualification and repeated timing samples remain separate planned work.
